title: Import Settings: Android system notification to allow file access not visible when requested on import, need to hit back to see it on previous screen
symptom: Upon a new installation of AndroidAPS, when importing backed up settings the first time, an Android system notification is needed to allow file access, but it is not visible on the 'Select file to import' screen. Only after pressing the back button does the notification appear on the previous screen, requiring the user to click allow and then retry import.
cause: The issue was a bug in the import flow where the system file access permission prompt was not shown on the correct screen.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit (d1009e53218e90aac17639ff876b13467057ef4a). The user confirmed that after trying the latest commit, the problem was resolved.
